name: Fleet Atlas
notes: Distant stars and the Milky Way band now use the same interpolated camera as the ship, so the starfield no longer stair-steps while the hull glides.

Sky wash cache is static per system. The old 4 Hz / rounded-camera rebake was hitching mid-cruise and, on a desynchronized opaque canvas, presenting an uninitialized white frame. Resize and leave-station now paint a dark fill immediately; #space has a matching CSS background.
Flight pacing, planets, ships, and the Flight menu Update button are unchanged. Service worker cache bumped to farbound-v2.15.7.
